properties.markdownProperty:
A **Section** gives a document its structure. It has a *Name*, which is shown as a numbered heading, and an optional *Comments* field. A section can hold **any kind of object**, including other sections, so you can build a hierarchy as deep as you need (1, 1.1, 1.1.1, ...). A section can be placed directly in a document or inside another section.
**Traceability**
- *Can be traced from other objects:* **No**. Its only class is `section`, not `traceable-object`, and symbolic links explicitly exclude sections as targets. - *Can have traces to other objects:* **No**. It has no trace properties.
